```{r ari-comparison-between-kmeans-and-rkm}
required_packages <- c(
  "readr", "dplyr", "mclust"
)

installed <- rownames(installed.packages())
missing_pkgs <- setdiff(required_packages, installed)

if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_pkgs)
}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(mclust)
```

```{r settings}
set.seed(123)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SETTINGS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
embedding_paths <- c(
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_64.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_128.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_256.csv"
)

k_to_compare <- c(3,4, 5,6, 7,8, 9,10)
q_range <- 2:6

dir.create("output/ari_results", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r helpers}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# HELPERS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Load best cached RKM result for a given embedding_tag and k
load_best_rkm_for_k <- function(embedding_tag, k_val, q_vals = 2:6,
                                cache_dir = "output/rkm_cache") {
  
  candidates <- list()
  
  for (q_val in q_vals) {
    cache_file <- file.path(
      cache_dir,
      paste0("rkm_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, "_q", q_val, ".rds")
    )
    
    if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
      cached <- readRDS(cache_file)
      
      candidates[[length(candidates) + 1]] <- list(
        k = k_val,
        q = q_val,
        asw = cached$asw,
        model = cached$model,
        file = cache_file
      )
    }
  }
  
  if (length(candidates) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  asw_vals <- sapply(candidates, function(x) x$asw)
  best_idx <- which.max(asw_vals)
  candidates[[best_idx]]
}

# Standard k-means for a fixed k
run_kmeans_for_k <- function(x, k_val,
                             nstart = 100,
                             iter.max = 100,
                             algorithm = "MacQueen",
                             scale_data = TRUE) {
  
  if (scale_data) {
    x <- scale(x)
  }
  
  km <- kmeans(
    x,
    centers = k_val,
    nstart = nstart,
    iter.max = iter.max,
    algorithm = algorithm
  )
  
  km
}
```

```{r compare}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# MAIN COMPARISON
# ------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(123)

ari_results <- list()

for (embedding_path in embedding_paths) {
  
  if (!file.exists(embedding_path)) {
    cat("Missing embedding file:", embedding_path, "\n")
    next
  }
  
  cat("\nProcessing:", embedding_path, "\n")
  
  embeddings <- read_csv(embedding_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  user_ids <- embeddings[[1]]
  embedding_matrix <- embeddings[, -1] |> as.matrix()
  
  embedding_tag <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(embedding_path))
  
  for (k_val in k_to_compare) {
    cat("  Comparing k =", k_val, "for", embedding_tag, "\n")
    
    # Load best cached RKM model for this k
    best_rkm <- load_best_rkm_for_k(
      embedding_tag = embedding_tag,
      k_val = k_val,
      q_vals = q_range,
      cache_dir = "output/rkm_cache"
    )
    
    if (is.null(best_rkm)) {
      cat("    No cached RKM files found for k =", k_val, "\n")
      next
    }
    
    # Run standard k-means for the same k
    km_model <- run_kmeans_for_k(
      x = embedding_matrix,
      k_val = k_val,
      nstart = 100,
      iter.max = 100,
      algorithm = "Hartigan-Wong",
      scale_data = TRUE
    )
    
    # Extract assignments
    kmeans_cluster <- km_model$cluster
    rkm_cluster <- best_rkm$model$cluster
    
    # Sanity check
    if (length(kmeans_cluster) != length(rkm_cluster)) {
      cat("    Cluster length mismatch for", embedding_tag, "k =", k_val, "\n")
      next
    }
    
    # Compute ARI
    ari_val <- adjustedRandIndex(kmeans_cluster, rkm_cluster)
    
    # Store per-user assignments too if you want
    assignment_df <- data.frame(
      UserID = user_ids,
      KMeans_Cluster = kmeans_cluster,
      RKM_Cluster = rkm_cluster
    )
    
    write.csv(
      assignment_df,
      file = file.path(
        "output/ari_results",
        paste0("cluster_assignment_compare_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, ".csv")
      ),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    
    # Summary row
    ari_results[[length(ari_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      embedding = embedding_tag,
      k = k_val,
      rkm_best_q = best_rkm$q,
      rkm_best_asw = best_rkm$asw,
      ari = ari_val,
      kmeans_cluster_sizes = paste(as.integer(table(kmeans_cluster)), collapse = "|"),
      rkm_cluster_sizes = paste(as.integer(table(rkm_cluster)), collapse = "|"),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}
```

```{r final}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# FINAL TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ari_results_df <- bind_rows(ari_results) %>%
  arrange(embedding, k)

print(ari_results_df)

write.csv(
  ari_results_df,
  file = "output/ari_results/ari_kmeans_vs_rkm_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r plot}
embedding_path <- "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_128.csv"
selected_k <- 5

embeddings <- read_csv(embedding_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

user_ids <- embeddings[[1]]
embedding_matrix <- embeddings[, -1] |> as.matrix()

embedding_tag <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(embedding_path))

# scale the data for k-means + PCA
x_scaled <- scale(embedding_matrix)
pca <- prcomp(x_scaled)

plot_df <- data.frame(
  UserID = user_ids,
  PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
  KMeans = factor(km_model$cluster),
  RKM = factor(rkm_models[[selected_k]]$cluster)
)

var_explained <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PLOT SIDE BY SIDE
# ------------------------------------------------------------
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
p_kmeans <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = KMeans)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = paste("K-means:", embedding_tag, "(k =", selected_k, ")"),
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * var_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * var_explained[2], 1), "%)"),
    color = "Cluster"
  )

p_rkm <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = RKM)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = paste("Reduced K-means:", embedding_tag,
                  "(k =", selected_k, ", q =", best_rkm$q, ")"),
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * var_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * var_explained[2], 1), "%)"),
    color = "Cluster"
  )

combined_plot <- p_kmeans + p_rkm + plot_layout(ncol = 2)

plot(combined_plot)
```
